overview: The Medford Community Development Board considered Dover Amendment site plan reviews for a Tufts University student housing building and a domestic violence shelter, alongside a definitive subdivision proposal on Franklin Avenue. The board voted to continue all three public hearings to January 15, 2025, while requesting municipal legal counsel guidance on Dover Amendment authority and project mitigation.

items.title: 401 Boston Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued the public hearing for Tufts University's proposed 10-story student residence hall to January 15, 2025, and voted to request legal counsel guidance regarding board authority and allowable mitigation under the Dover Amendment.

items.title: 21 St. Clair Road Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued the public hearing for Halo House Inc. and Assisi Holdings LLC's proposed 34-room domestic violence shelter to January 15, 2025, and voted to request city legal counsel attend the next meeting to advise on Dover Amendment eligibility.

items.title: Bridle Path Definitive Subdivision
items.summary: Continued the public hearing for North Shore Residential Development Inc.'s proposed eight-lot single-family residential subdivision off Franklin Avenue to January 15, 2025, to allow city departments to review updated plans.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Business
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from November 6, 2024, and briefly acknowledged the City Council's recent approval of the MACD zoning amendment.
